Parts.Description: Black glassy rock veined with red, glowing lava cracks and a red-ringed plaza under the Demon Shiba.
Parts.Name: Obsidian Ground

Parts.Description: Two black columns with iron bowls and roaring red fire greet everybody at the gate.
Parts.Name: Entrance Braziers

Parts.Description: A blood-red signboard in a black horned frame on two posts, topped with a skull.
Parts.Name: Hell Sign

Parts.Description: A long black iron fence of spear points along the road edge, between two skull-topped stone posts.
Parts.Name: Spike Fence

Parts.Description: A mound of skulls, ribs and thigh bones with a spear and a grinning skull on top.
Parts.Name: Bone Heap

Parts.Description: Three bubbling pools of orange lava ringed with dark rock, with jagged boulders around them.
Parts.Name: Lava Pools

Parts.Description: A cluster of tall black glass spikes jutting out of the ground, a few veined red.
Parts.Name: Obsidian Shards

Parts.Description: Three burnt black trees with bare, clawing branches and glowing embers at their feet.
Parts.Name: Charred Trees

Parts.Description: A huge black cauldron of bubbling green brew on three legs over a crackling fire, bones at its feet.
Parts.Name: Witch Cauldron

Parts.Description: Three yellow-crusted smoking vents that hiss grey brimstone clouds.
Parts.Name: Sulfur Vents

Parts.Description: Two grinning purple imps on rock pedestals, horns up and little wings spread.
Parts.Name: Imp Statues

Parts.Description: Two giant horned pillars stand either side of the walkway, a heavy iron chain hanging between them.
Parts.Name: Gate Pillars

Parts.Description: Three tall iron poles stacked with bleached skulls and crowned with horns.
Parts.Name: Skull Totems

Parts.Description: A spiked black doghouse with a glowing red doorway, a bone-filled bowl and a chain on a stake.
Parts.Name: Hell Kennel

Parts.Description: A black gallows frame with three iron cages hanging on chains, each holding a skull.
Parts.Name: Iron Cages

Parts.Description: A blood-red summoning circle on the ground, five black standing stones and a bone altar with a skull.
Parts.Name: Ritual Circle

Parts.Description: Three tall spiked war standards flying tattered blood-red banners.
Parts.Name: War Banners

Parts.Description: A round rock basin of molten lava with a black spire in the middle, spouting orange lava into the air.
Parts.Name: Lava Fountain

Parts.Description: A humped bridge of bone planks and rib railings across a river of lava, skulls on the posts.
Parts.Name: Bone Bridge

Parts.Description: The broken black wall of an old demon fortress with crumbled towers and rubble.
Parts.Name: Ruined Fortress Wall

Parts.Description: A tall black watchtower with glowing red windows, a spiked battlement and a horned roof.
Parts.Name: Dark Watchtower

Parts.Description: A colossal black stone demon with curled horns, folded bat wings and a great sword planted in front of him.
Parts.Name: Demon Statue

Parts.Description: Three stepped black platforms around a great iron fire bowl blazing red, a spike at each corner.
Parts.Name: Fire Altar

Parts.Description: A glowing lava channel with black rock banks running round three sides of the throne ground.
Parts.Name: Lava Moat

Parts.Description: A mountain of black rock studded with skulls and crowned by one enormous horned skull.
Parts.Name: Skull Mountain

Parts.Description: A towering horned arch of black and red rock spanning the walkway, a great skull on its keystone.
Parts.Name: Gate Arch

Parts.Description: Two giant black bat wings with bone fingers and blood-red membranes spread behind the throne.
Parts.Name: Wing Backdrop

Parts.Description: A black spiked throne on a stepped red dais, a skull on its tall back and a bone spike on each side.
Parts.Name: Demon Throne

Parts.Description: A very tall tapering obsidian tower with red-lit balconies, crowned by a spiked iron cage of blazing fire.
Parts.Name: Hellfire Spire

Parts.Description: A huge ring of horned black rock holding a swirling red whirlpool of hellfire.
Parts.Name: Hellfire Portal
